known_failures: Character-level splitting replaces the text node, so screen readers may announce fragments rather than the phrase unless an aria-label carries the full string
Animating many characters concurrently is a main-thread cost that surfaces as INP on low-end mobile

lifecycle.retirement_condition: Retire if the upstream license changes in a way that removes gateway installation as a lawful path, or if a CPP-owned equivalent reaches equal maturity under an unrestricted license.

abstention_conditions: The project's DESIGN.md declares no motion budget, or the budget is already spent
The surface is a product or operational view rather than an expressive hero
The animation would compete with the primary interaction rather than establish hierarchy
The consuming project distributes its own component library, because the restriction propagates downstream
